svg.title: In seven of eight economies the leading indicator rose from September 2025 to September 2026, and in one it fell
svg.desc: Slope chart: In seven of eight economies the leading indicator rose from September 2025 to September 2026, and in one it fell: September 2025: United States: 99.6, Japan: 99.7, Germany: 100.5, China: 100.3, India: 100.0, Brazil: 100.1, Korea: 99.7, Türkiye: 99.6; September 2026: United States: 101.0, Japan: 100.4, Germany: 101.0, China: 97.4, India: 102.0, Brazil: 102.4, Korea: 102.5, Türkiye: 100.7.
